scope: Root portable and native driver tests, tagged frame accounting and affected upstream packages; enumerated project/prepared source plus toolchain identity. No full compiler/module-cache/system SDK closure, performance budgets or physical GPU/human accessibility certification.

checks.name: toolchain
argv:
export VELLUM_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/vellum-p0-cache
. /private/tmp/vellum-large-data/drivers/cogent/env.sh

go env GOOS GOARCH GOVERSION GOCACHE GOMODCACHE GOWORK
